name: checkout
description: Cart drawer + one-page checkout for Shopify stores (multi-store).

scripts.e2e:prepare: npm run build:storefront && cd apps/server && DATABASE_URL=${E2E_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://checkout:checkout@localhost:5432/checkout_e2e} npx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=${E2E_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://checkout:checkout@localhost:5432/checkout_e2e} npx tsx scripts/reset-and-seed.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:prepare && npx playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
